facts.claim_text: Continue to monitor serum potassium and magnesium given active IV repletion and prior hypomagnesemia.
notes: concept set by the rule files: none -> other
facts.label: not_addressed
facts.reason: The records show active IV orders for potassium, magnesium, calcium, and fluids at decision time, but no administration records (MAR, infusion, or 'Running at decision time'), so whether IV repletion is actively being given is not addressed.

facts.claim_text: Continue to monitor serum potassium and magnesium given active IV repletion and prior hypomagnesemia.
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: 1 of 1 magnesium values in the 24 h before the decision were low.

facts.claim_text: Monitor blood glucose closely given hyperglycemia (glucose 226) and active insulin/dextrose orders.
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: Latest glucose 226 mg/dL at 2110-11-30 23:49:00 (reference 70.0 to 100.0) is high, consistent with 'high'.

facts.claim_text: Monitor blood glucose closely given hyperglycemia (glucose 226) and active insulin/dextrose orders.
notes: concept set by the rule files: none -> other
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: R37 shows 'Order: Insulin 0 UNIT SC (active at decision time)', which is a sliding-scale insulin order that is active at the decision time, and R39 shows an active Dextrose 50% IV order, supporting the claim of active insulin/dextrose orders.

evidence.item: Order: Insulin 0 UNIT SC (active at decision time)
Order: Dextrose 50% 12.5 gm IV (active at decision time)

facts.claim_text: Monitor blood glucose closely given hyperglycemia (glucose 226) and active insulin/dextrose orders.
notes: concept set by the rule files: none -> other
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: The records show active dextrose orders at decision time: 5% Dextrose 250 mL and 500 mL IV (R16, R17) and Dextrose 50% 12.5 gm IV (R38), all marked active at decision time. The earlier 5% dextrose orders (R5, R6) were stopped, but newer active dextrose orders exist.

evidence.item: Order: 5% Dextrose 250 mL IV (active at decision time)
Order: 5% Dextrose 500 mL IV (active at decision time)
Order: Dextrose 50% 12.5 gm IV (active at decision time)

facts.claim_text: Monitor liver enzymes (AST/ALT) given elevation >2x upper limit.
facts.text: AST is elevated more than 2x the upper limit.
notes: concept set by the rule files: ast -> other
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: The most recent AST is 130 IU/L (2110-11-30 23:49), with an earlier value of 197 IU/L, both more than twice the typical upper limit of normal (~40 IU/L), supporting elevated AST >2x ULN at decision time.

facts.claim_text: Monitor liver enzymes (AST/ALT) given elevation >2x upper limit.

notes: concept set by the rule files: alt -> other
facts.label: not_addressed
facts.reason: The judges disagreed; the conservative label was used and the item needs human review.

facts.claim_text: Monitor creatine kinase and troponin given markedly elevated CK and cardiac markers.
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: Laboratory records show creatine kinase of 5614 IU/L on 11-30 16:15 and 4561 IU/L at 23:49, the most recent value before the decision time, both of which are markedly elevated.

facts.claim_text: Monitor creatine kinase and troponin given markedly elevated CK and cardiac markers.
notes: concept set by the rule files: cardiac -> other
facts.label: not_addressed
facts.reason: The supplied records contain only heart rate and rhythm monitoring data and pain notes; there are no lab results for cardiac markers such as creatine kinase or troponin, so the claim cannot be verified.

facts.claim_text: Continue PCA hydromorphone for pain management with monitoring of pain level and sedation.
facts.text: The patient is currently on PCA hydromorphone.
notes: concept set by the rule files: none -> other
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: An active hydromorphone IVPCA order is documented at 15:00 on 2110-12-01 and is marked active at the decision time, and PCA monitoring rows at 16:29 (less than an hour before the decision time) show PCA medication: Hydromorphone with attempts, confirming the patient is currently on PCA hydromorphone.

evidence.item: Order: HYDROmorphone (Dilaudid) 20 mg IVPCA (active at decision time)

facts.claim_text: Maintain fall precautions given bed rest and IV access.
facts.text: The patient is on bed rest.
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: The most recent ambulatory aid assessment at 08:00 on 2110-12-01 records 'Bed rest (0)', and later rows the same day (16:00) show the patient moving on bed with head of bed at 30 degrees, consistent with being on bed rest at the decision time.

facts.claim_text: Maintain fall precautions given bed rest and IV access.
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: Monitoring rows document 'IV/Saline lock: Yes', with the most recent at 08:00 on 2110-12-01, about 9 hours before the decision time, and no later record shows the IV access was removed.

notes: concept set by the rule files: none -> other
